items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild, and an emergency hotfix (VULN-39341) has been released.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying this update in addition to the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including those that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. One notable fix includes an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability via Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: This critical remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source is caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types. Attackers can exploit this flaw to inject malicious scripts and achieve arbitrary code execution.
